notes.sheet: refs/glyphs.svg - 1200x900, background #f2f3f5, 4x3 grid of 300x300 cells, every glyph drawn at 2.4x inside its own 100x100 local box (faint box outline + centre tick = guide, not part of the glyph).
notes.usage: glyphs.<name>.svg is inline-ready inner markup (a <g> tree) authored in a 0..100 local box: drop it inside any <g transform="translate(tx ty) scale(s)"> or inside a <svg viewBox="0 0 100 100">. No <text>, no fonts, no external references. "standalone" is the same art wrapped in its own <svg> for a quick file-level preview.
notes.centring: Each glyph is auto-positioned so its measured ink bbox is centred in the 0..100 box (measured from a 3200px render over a padded viewBox, thresholded at 50% alpha; <=0.1 unit antialias fringe included).
notes.colours: triangle / circle / cross / square / ps-logo / create / options / mic-mute use fill|stroke="currentColor" (inherits; defaults to black). mic-hole and usb-c carry explicit dark greys because their look depends on colour.
notes.weights: All PlayStation shapes share one 9/100 weight (ring wall = 9 units of the 100-unit box, i.e. 9% of the glyph box).

glyphNotes.triangle: PlayStation triangle: upwards rounded-corner ring, 9/100 wall, equilateral-ish with a slightly flat base.
glyphNotes.circle: PlayStation circle: perfect ring, uniform 9/100 wall.
glyphNotes.cross: PlayStation cross: two 104 x 18 rounded bars at +/-45 deg (bar ~5.8x its thickness), round caps.
glyphNotes.square: PlayStation square: upright axis-aligned ring, 9/100 wall, outer corner radius 12 (inner 3).
glyphNotes.ps-logo: PlayStation PS monogram: italic capital P (stem 15 wide, cap 74 tall, 15-unit bowl wall) leaning on a shear of 0.24 about the design baseline y=88, with a smaller capital S (two tangent r=11 arcs + middle diagonal, stroked 12, cap ~62) overlapping behind it on the right. One solid colour; a 1.5-unit transparent gap is knocked out of the S around the P silhouette so the overlap reads. Uses <mask id="pslogoGap">; rename the id if you inline two copies into one document (identical definitions, so a duplicated id still renders correctly).
glyphNotes.create: DualSense Create: share glyph - 3 hollow nodes (r=7.5) + 2 links, 2-unit stroke, round caps.
glyphNotes.options: DualSense Options: 3 equal 62-long horizontal lines, 8 thick, 22 apart, round caps.
glyphNotes.mic-mute: Microphone: capsule (18x37 pill) + cradle arc (r=22 centred on y=44) + stem and base bar + subtle mute slash.
glyphNotes.mic-hole: Microphone hole: dark disc r=25 with a lighter soft rim ring (inner disc r=20).
glyphNotes.usb-c: USB-C receptacle from the front: 76x24 slot (r=12), darker inner cavity, 62x7 metal tongue.

notes.psLogoNote: ps-logo is authored in an upright italic-capital frame (P cap 14..88, P x 8..64, S skeleton x 68..92) and then sheared; the finished ink is scaled so its longest side is 84 units. The shear axis IS the slanted baseline (horizontal baseline, letters leaning right), which is how Sony draws it.
